verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Adyen Issuing creates virtual and physical Visa/Mastercard cards funded from balance accounts. Nothing in the pack documents distinct debit, prepaid, commercial credit, or consumer credit programs. Card form factor and network choice are a different axis from card-program type, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform supports the card types my product needs — debit, prepaid, commercial credit, and consumer credit programs — not just one prepaid rail
